result.summary: Read §9 of lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md directly (lines 335-508) and confirmed via `git diff 4655635a 7e54e897 -- lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md` that the commit is a pure append (only new `+` lines from '## 9. AMENDMENT' onward; §§1-8 byte-identical). All five acceptance criteria verified independently: (1) §9.1 explicitly evaluates and rejects candidate (A) `status == :passed` by name, for exactly the reason flagged (it would reject a legitimate :teardown_failed/assertions_failed==0 rehearsal, contradicting R8's documented gate condition); chosen fix (B) `status not in [:running]` is confirmed in §9.1's own text to admit :passed, :failed, and :teardown_failed (excludes only :running, one of four enum values). (3) New error reason `:assertion_run_in_progress` (§9.3) is distinct from the three prior new reasons (:assertion_run_missing, :assertion_run_digest_mismatch, :assertion_run_failed) and from the pre-existing plain-atom reasons; §9.3's prose explicitly distinguishes it from :assertion_run_missing and :assertion_run_failed by caller-facing meaning. (4) No executable Elixir in §9 -- the fenced block in §9.2 is numbered plain-English prose steps (not Elixir syntax), and the `@type`/`@spec` additions in §9.3 are type-shape declarations only, consistent with the accepted style of the unchanged §§1-8. (5) Confirmed via git diff that §9 is a strict append with zero modification to §§1-8's existing text.
